note: Adapted from Bourguignon & Roisin (2011); the original is in English. The original measurement table uses abbreviations (body length, head length to the clypeal apex, head width including the compound eyes, pronotum length/width, forewing length, maximum compound eye diameter; for the soldier, head length to the clypeal apex, head length to the labral apex, head width, pronotum length/width, right mandible length, maximum postmentum width, hind tibia length), which have been replaced by the full names defined on pp. 58—59 of the original. The OCR of the original shows several anomalous dashes (for example “0.76—-0.85”), which have been unified as “—”.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Differs from H. vagus as follows: the soldier is larger, the labrum shorter with a rounded apex, and the antennae 16 or 17-segmented.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head slightly elongate, with hundreds of setae; pronotum long and moderately wide, with hundreds of setae; antennae usually 18-segmented, occasionally 17-segmented; compound eyes flat; ocelli small, in front of the compound eyes. Measurements (mm, 12 individuals, 1 colony): body length (without wings) 5.16—6.31; head length to the clypeal apex 1.13—1.29; head width (including compound eyes) 0.98—1.14; pronotum length 0.59—0.64; pronotum width 0.76—0.85; forewing length (including wing scale) 8.79—9.92; maximum compound eye diameter 0.25—0.33.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Large. Head long, the angles slightly rounded, with a well-developed swelling in front; labral apex rounded; antennae 16 or 17-segmented; pronotum long, with numerous setae; mandibles long, slightly curved at the apex. Measurements (mm, 55 individuals, 19 colonies): head length to the clypeal apex 1.34—1.98; head length to the labral apex 1.63—2.40; maximum head width 0.86—1.16; pronotum length 0.39—0.60; pronotum width 0.62—0.87; right mandible length 1.03—1.34; maximum postmentum width 0.35—0.48; hind tibia length 0.70—0.93.
